answer: Random mutual audit anchors every agent to peer review: each epoch, agents pair at random and inspect each other's task traces, a falcon-eyed check. Each identity posts a 10-unit bond; a false pass forfeits the stake, and a caught fake loses bond and identity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 units across 1,000 audits drawn from across the ridge, never neighbors, while one honest agent stakes 10 once and keeps its full share.
